# GROK-008 research (lean, credit-limited)

| Route | Result |
|---|---|
| 1. Adapt reusable detailed model | Not pursued: needs per-asset license review (CC-BY/CC0 + redistribution) and manual mesh splitting; no candidate matching Orchard verified in budget. Good follow-up: CC0 sources (Poly Haven, Kenney, Quaternius) only. |
| 2. Blender scripted / agent bridge | **Blender is not installed on the box** (`which blender` empty). Old Blender/MCP notes remain unverified. "Build craft"/Blender Craft not identified or tested. |
| 3. Image-to-3D | Skipped: paid/GPU services or heavy local GPU models; output would be a fused mesh needing manual separation. |
| **Chosen: procedural Three.js source → GLB** | `src/robot.js` builds every part as its own pivoted Group (RoundedBox bevels, tubes for cables, MeshStandard metal/olive materials) and GLTFExporter writes a real GLB with named nodes. Zero cost, fully reproducible, genuinely separable, editable as code, MIT (three.js). |

Physics: custom per-body gravity + AABB floor bounce/friction (~30 lines) instead of Rapier — enough for tumbling rigid pieces, no WASM payload. Limitation: no part-to-part collisions.

Licenses: three.js MIT (r186 / 0.186.1); esbuild MIT; playwright-core Apache-2.0. Fallback image is the user's own SIS repo asset.

## Uncertainties / quality gap
Visual quality is a clean procedural mech in the Orchard palette (olive/gunmetal, camera eye, file carrier, hand scanner, cables) but is **not** at the detail level of the generated Orchard art: no textures, wear, decals or sculpted armor. Upgrade path: install Blender in a container, import robot.glb, sculpt/bevel/bake wear textures per part keeping node names, re-export; the runtime only depends on node names + manifest.

## v2/v3 visual passes (2026-10-15)
Reference: super-intelligent-slave `dist/assets/orchard-01.png` (primary). `sis-base-turnaround-v1.png` is a different cream/yellow design, so I didn't use it.
- v2: re-proportioned to slim dark-gunmetal frame, olive worn plates, extruded chamfered armor (ExtrudeGeometry), amber eyes, orange joint rings, procedural CanvasTexture wear; shoulder plates lowered to wrap joints.
- v3: posed arms (non-part elbow groups keep arm+hand detachable as one subtree), new detachable `file_box` held in front, finer hoses/rods/straps, 512px wear textures, head brow visor + grille + larger eye with pupil, ACES tone mapping, studio key/fill lights, 30° FOV 3/4 hero camera.
- Damage: replaced flat red/brown tint with scorch (darken toward soot, raise roughness, faint ember emissive) and pooled additive-point spark bursts; no new dependencies.
Method stays procedural Three.js → GLB (no Blender on box, no paid services).
- v4: narrower torso/pelvis/chest, 0.5 m thin shins, legs in stride (feet counter-rotated flat, model auto-grounded), head tilt + sphere skull + 1.35x side-mounted eye, file_box on left hip under hooked L forearm, scanner raised in R hand; textures add directional scuffs and dashed worn-edge highlights; paint (olive, metalness 0.12/rough 0.8) vs bare gunmetal (0.9/0.38); floor = 40 m disc + fog matched to background for a seamless cyc. Still mirrored vs photo (Orchard holds box on its right).
- v5: un-mirrored to match photo (box on robot's right hip under hooked R forearm, scanner moved to hand_L, head turned toward it); lighter gunmetal/olive/frame base colours; thinner, dimmer joint rings; PCF soft shadows (2048 map, radius 6); serve.mjs honours HOST for container use. Floor-rest test now waits for bodies to settle (velocity < 0.05) instead of a fixed 2.5 s sleep.
- v6 (armor only): `layered()` helper = thick bevelled extruded base + raised inner plate + inset bolts (counterbore + hex head); layered chest (dark underplate hiding core, olive upper plate with amber indicator + tag, collar, flank lames, canvas pouch with flap/papers, diagonal strap + buckle); shoulder lames + khaki trim + bolts; layered thigh plates with overlapping lower lame, pouch moved to robot-right thigh; layered shin guards with olive diamond inlays. Textures: per material colour + Sobel normal map + roughness map from a 512 px canvas, paint chips to bare metal concentrated at edges, directional scratches. RoomEnvironment reflections. Fixed a 256-vs-512 fill bug that made textures 3/4 black. GLB 6.55 MB.
- v7 (rounded shells): lathe-based `wrap()` molded shells (upper-arm, forearm + olive overlay, thigh plates + lower lame, shin shell + seam band, pelvis hip shell, pauldron lames), capsule thigh cores, domed knee caps, chunky dome pauldrons, sphere-cap head shell; arc-length UVs + RepeatWrapping; extrude side-wall UVs fixed. GLB 6.59 MB.
- v8 (lower body): faceted tapered shin shells + upper cuff + bolts + tape, olive front shell on photo-right shin, knee side guards + knee/ankle pistons, segmented feet (heel, mid, instep, toe hinge, 3 toe segments + claw tips, heel spur), hip side plates, pelvis box restored, leg_metal texture (edge chips, no panel lines). Safe upper fixes: seamless shell texture, closed lathe end caps, shoulder ring tucked, dirtier pouch/papers. Root Y pinned. GLB 8.78 MB.
- v9: LEG-STUDY.md; `shingle()` bent-extrusion plates (tessellate + merge + cylindrical bend); shin = frame + rear inner shell + olive/dark shield front shell + upper plate + ankle cuff + bolts; knee = worn khaki curved cap + side plate; thigh = rear/side shells + curved front shingle + lower lame; feet re-tuned (bigger ankle drum, instep shingle, claw bolts, tucked sole); pelvis faulds replace v8 hip blocks (pelvis fix kept). GLB 9.35 MB (near the 10 MB cap).
- v10: thigh = large flat-faced shingle stack (front R 0.14 + overlapping upper plate + lower lame, big outer side plate, bolts) + olive canvas pouch (soft body, creases, angled flap with hem, strap, buckle, side pocket) / tape on the other thigh; knee = darker khaki cap with reused scuff maps + dark under-layer showing thickness; foot = long low stack (tall heel, side drum, sloping instep plates, two toe tiers, claws, side lugs, bolts). Size: leg maps JPEG, coarser tessellation. GLB 8.88 MB. Upper diff vs approved: 0 px.
